About v2: All 13 profiles were cut to transparent PNGs from Lucian's uploaded photos (PNG masters kept in the project; the site loads optimized renditions of the same cutouts). Each section is themed by the jersey in its photo — team lettering font, team colors, tinted vignette and glow. Jaylen Brown (Sixers No. 7) identified by Lucian. Cade Cunningham read from his No. 2 piston pendant and Detroit Fila fit. No ratings are shown in this edition — the showcase is the style.
